mapper.select: SELECT re.room_id AS id, mr.name AS name, mr.location AS location, re.quantity AS quantity FROM room_equipment re LEFT JOIN meeting_room mr ON mr.id = re.room_id AND mr.deleted = 0 WHERE re.deleted = 0 AND re.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY re.create_time DESC

SELECT e.id AS id, e.code AS code, e.name AS name, e.category AS category, e.brand AS brand, e.model AS model, e.status AS status, e.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, e.description AS description, e.create_time AS createTime, re.quantity AS quantity FROM room_equipment re LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.id = re.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE re.deleted = 0 AND re.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY re.create_time DESC
